nodes.name: execution-client.test.ts
nodes.summary: Bộ kiểm thử TypeScript cho `execution-client.ts, read-client.ts, runtime-context.ts`: bao phủ: sends one native background create with reject policy and trusted config outside message input; distinguishes explicit rejection from lost/malformed ACK without retrying mutations. Bao phủ runtime execution, context và streaming.

nodes.name: findings-artifacts.test.ts
nodes.summary: Bộ kiểm thử TypeScript cho `artifacts-service.ts, error-handler.ts, findings-service.ts, findings.routes.ts`: bao phủ: W12 findings projection; parses FIND-*.md into public views with quality flags and bounded raw source; flags parser defaults and keeps malformed findings viewable via raw source. Bao phủ findings, artifacts và timeline.

nodes.name: graph-service.test.ts
nodes.summary: Bộ kiểm thử TypeScript cho `graph-service.ts`: bao phủ: W13 scoped graph projection; projects an engagement-scoped graph with whitelisted, redacted properties and bounded edges; keeps a scoped empty graph truthful (200) and distinct from an unavailable store (503). Bao phủ đồ thị tấn công và projection lịch sử.

nodes.name: history-projection.test.ts
nodes.summary: Bộ kiểm thử TypeScript cho `history-projection.ts, run-service.ts`: bao phủ: projectThreadHistory; keeps checkpoint history thread-level with stable provenance keys and full-vs-capped truth; deduplicates parallel branch duplicates by provenance key and keeps distinct identities. Bao phủ đồ thị tấn công và projection lịch sử.

nodes.name: iw08-campaign-job-ledger.test.ts
nodes.summary: Bộ kiểm thử TypeScript cho `campaign-job-ledger.ts`: bao phủ: IW-08 durable campaign request identity; replays one durable job when the same request is retried; rejects reuse of a request ID for a different operation. Bao phủ chiến dịch phishing và ledger job.

nodes.name: iw08-evilginx-client.test.ts
nodes.summary: Bộ kiểm thử TypeScript cho `env.ts, evilginx-client.ts`: bao phủ: IW-08 typed evilginx bridge client; accepts native lure ID zero and its scoped lab metadata; rejects a manifest belonging to a different engagement. Bao phủ chiến dịch phishing và ledger job.

nodes.name: iw08-evilginx-service.test.ts
nodes.summary: Bộ kiểm thử TypeScript cho `evilginx-campaign-service.ts, evilginx-client.ts`: bao phủ: IW-08 evilginx lab campaign service; persists a prepared bundle with a version bump and replays retries without a second native call; refuses deployment before a prepared bundle exists. Bao phủ chiến dịch phishing và ledger job.

nodes.name: iw08-gophish-deployment.test.ts
nodes.summary: Bộ kiểm thử TypeScript cho `campaign-deployment-service.ts, gophish-client.ts`: bao phủ: IW-08 GoPhish lab dispatch and reconciliation; records accepted submission and retries without posting another campaign; projects native SMTP acceptance counts without claiming inbox delivery. Bao phủ chiến dịch phishing và ledger job.

nodes.name: iw08-gophish-preparation.test.ts
nodes.summary: Bộ kiểm thử TypeScript cho `c2-service.ts, campaign-service.ts, campaign.routes.ts, env.ts`: bao phủ: IW-08 GoPhish asset preparation; reads native assets without returning recipients or SMTP credentials; persists a prepared manifest through the scoped generate route and reload. Bao phủ chiến dịch phishing và ledger job.

nodes.name: iw09-c2.test.ts
nodes.summary: Bộ kiểm thử TypeScript cho `c2-service.ts, env.ts, sliver-client.ts`: bao phủ: IW-09 C2 ownership and durable command audit; lists only sessions in the authorized engagement namespace; rejects foreign engagement ownership before command dispatch. Bao phủ C2/Sliver và điều phối phiên.

nodes.name: planning.test.ts
nodes.summary: Bộ kiểm thử TypeScript cho `app.ts, projects-service.ts`: bao phủ: serves all missing planning states through the owned new API and hides other owners; distinguishes malformed, schema-invalid and valid docs without returning unknown keys or deconfliction secrets; matches the eight-document handoff policy without requiring OPPLAN and blocks wrong target, name or authorization.

nodes.name: project-policy.test.ts
nodes.summary: Bộ kiểm thử TypeScript cho `identity-provider.ts, project-policy.ts, workspace-policy.ts`: bao phủ: project slug policy; matches the legacy 3-64 lowercase/digit/internal-hyphen rule; rejects titles, separators, traversal and encoded traversal. Tập trung chính sách, slug và kiểm soát workspace.

nodes.name: projects.test.ts
nodes.summary: Bộ kiểm thử TypeScript cho `error-handler.ts, projects-service.ts, projects.routes.ts`: bao phủ: GET /api/engagements; lists projects as public view models with null projections and no field leaks; marks legacy confirmed rows with semantically invalid targets needs_review.

nodes.name: request-fingerprint.test.ts
nodes.summary: Bộ kiểm thử TypeScript cho `request-fingerprint.ts`: bao phủ: fingerprints JSON intent independently of key order but preserves exact string/array content; refuses unsupported JSON values and bounded oversized/deep payloads.

nodes.name: run-policy.test.ts
nodes.summary: Bộ kiểm thử TypeScript cho `run-policy.ts`: bao phủ: accepts only thread kind/assistant selection and a stable client intent ID; preserves exact user message intent while rejecting SDK command/options and oversized input; bounds owned-run pagination and rejects arbitrary upstream filters. Tập trung chính sách, slug và kiểm soát workspace.

nodes.name: runtime-context.test.ts
nodes.summary: Bộ kiểm thử TypeScript cho `projects-service.ts, request-fingerprint.ts, runtime-context.ts, runtime.ts`: bao phủ: resolves the five CLI configurable fields from persisted metadata and trusted POSIX mapping; does not contact runtime for another owner or privileged browser overrides; selects only actually discovered allowlisted assistants and refuses implicit assistant switches. Bao phủ runtime execution, context và streaming.

nodes.name: runtime-read-client.test.ts
nodes.summary: Bộ kiểm thử TypeScript cho `read-client.ts`: bao phủ: discovers reachable graphs with deduplication and validates scoped thread/state identities; returns unavailable without static catalog fallback for malformed discovery and missing threads; keeps its deadline through delayed response bodies and bounds decoded JSON size. Bao phủ runtime execution, context và streaming.

nodes.name: stream-projection.test.ts
nodes.summary: Bộ kiểm thử TypeScript cho `stream-projection.ts`: bao phủ: preserves parallel invocation identity, nullable call ID, seconds and terminal flags; projects public messages/tool arguments without state, private reasoning, provider keys or system content; distinguishes tuple message chunks from legacy cumulative arrays and commits only the final projected event cursor. Bao phủ runtime execution, context và streaming.

nodes.name: stream-service.test.ts
nodes.summary: Bộ kiểm thử TypeScript cho `app.ts, join-client.ts, projects-service.ts, stream-service.ts`: bao phủ: authorizes each join/reconnect, forwards only upstream cursors and observes through GET without runtime cancellation; denies foreign run scope and malformed/arbitrary cursor options before joining upstream. Bao phủ runtime execution, context và streaming.

nodes.name: w05-live.ts
nodes.summary: Bộ kiểm thử TypeScript cho `app.ts, client.ts, engagements-repository.ts, projects-service.ts`: hàm kiểm thử: failure, http.

nodes.name: w07-faults.ts
nodes.summary: Bộ kiểm thử TypeScript cho `app.ts, client.ts, engagements-repository.ts, execution-client.ts`: hàm kiểm thử: releaseFirst, releaseSecond, http.

nodes.name: w11-controls.test.ts
nodes.summary: Bộ kiểm thử TypeScript cho `interrupt-projection.ts, read-client.ts, run-service.ts`: bao phủ: pending interrupt projection; restores the question from __interrupt__ envelopes and nested task values; validates answers against option labels, allow_other and multi-select semantics.

nodes.name: w14-logs-reports.test.ts
nodes.summary: Bộ kiểm thử TypeScript cho `artifacts-service.ts, error-handler.ts, export-service.ts, run-service.ts`: bao phủ: W14 operations timeline; merges runtime, checkpoint and workspace entries with distinct labels, newest first; flags truncation when run pages overflow and keeps artifact mtime as presence marker only. Bao phủ findings, artifacts và timeline.

nodes.name: w15-settings.test.ts
nodes.summary: Bộ kiểm thử TypeScript cho `error-handler.ts, projects-service.ts, settings-service.ts, settings.routes.ts`: bao phủ: W15 engagement settings; returns the persisted view with an up-front target-change policy; states the lifecycle and runtime-lock reasons that block target changes. Bao phủ vault/members/settings và phân quyền.

nodes.name: w17-campaigns.test.ts
nodes.summary: Bộ kiểm thử TypeScript cho `c2-service.ts, campaign-service.ts, campaign.routes.ts, capabilities.routes.ts`: bao phủ: W17 campaign drafts; creates and lists persisted drafts with valid DTOs; rejects invalid drafts with field attribution and duplicate names with 409. Bao phủ chiến dịch phishing và ledger job.

nodes.name: w18-vault.test.ts
nodes.summary: Bộ kiểm thử TypeScript cho `capabilities.routes.ts, env.ts, error-handler.ts, vault-service.ts`: bao phủ: W18 vault storage; stores secrets encrypted and returns redacted metadata only; reveals plaintext only through the explicit endpoint and audits every reveal. Bao phủ vault/members/settings và phân quyền.

nodes.name: w19-members.test.ts
nodes.summary: Bộ kiểm thử TypeScript cho `capabilities.routes.ts, error-handler.ts, members-service.ts, members.routes.ts`: bao phủ: W19 members; returns the truthful local single-user view with the stated invite reason; answers 503 with the explicit reason for invite and removal attempts. Bao phủ vault/members/settings và phân quyền.
